dimension_justifications.soundness: Replay-model claims are bounded, but reported empirical and derived results cannot be independently rerun from the package: headline result JSONs lack producing scripts and included scripts refer to absent development-workspace inputs.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The manuscript, limitations, evidence map, AI-use statement, and Figure 1 mixed-role disclosure are clear. Supplementary reproduction instructions point to unavailable paths, making the stated route misleading for a clean checkout.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The count-exchangeable replay certificate and FIT/CAL/TEST framing are distinct and potentially useful, with locally hash-traceable artifacts. Practical value is constrained by inability to reproduce the central evidence and absent ordered-online/correctness/cost endpoints.

paper_summary: The paper proposes BAYES-H, an adaptive rule whose exact posterior certificate controls disagreement between a random-prefix binary pass-count decision and corresponding full-N decision under count-exchangeable replay. It reports replay count reductions, synthetic drift, and other carrier analyses while separating them from ordered-online deployment, delivered-answer correctness, and operational cost.
strongest_verified_contribution: The supplied source builds deterministically: two clean local rebuilds produced archived PDF hash 8138d3434d8886d299b402d2fe73837eadb87e57ea256cd12d975573fc3f0dad. All 97 manifest file hashes matched, and Figure 1 has detailed generated-composition and quantitative-label provenance.
strengths: The source-to-PDF path is self-contained and deterministic.
FIT/CAL/TEST and prospective ordered-correctness-cost study are separated; latter is planned/unexecuted.
The manuscript states replay metrics are not delivered-answer correctness or operational cost.
Figure 1 has hash-bound image history and label provenance.
The package is visibly anonymous and discloses exclusion of identity-bearing historical paths.
All active citekeys have local metadata/support locks.
questions: Can authors provide a clean-checkout command regenerating headline OMR, shard, OpenR1, RLVE, drift, and margin JSONs from bundled or documented-fetch inputs?
Why does the current-manuscript checker require an absent remote_snapshot tree, and can a snapshot-local checker replace it?
Can authors specify canonical serialization/command for snapshot_sha256?
Can Figure 2 receive provenance including generating script, exact inputs, and output-hash verification?

issues.location: artifacts/REPRO_README; artifacts/results; experiment registry EXP-OMR-R469 and EXP-DRIFT-R469
issues.observed_evidence: README commands require absent workspace directories and raw parquet carriers. Of 34 bundled result JSONs, 20 have no same-stem producing script, including headline OMR, drift, margin, shard, and RLVE results. Several scripts import absent sibling runners or pinned parquet inputs.
issues.why_it_matters: Central numbers are immutable and hashable but cannot be independently regenerated or checked, preventing validation that code, inputs, split logic, and outputs agree beyond trusting JSON.
issues.required_fix: Release a clean self-contained reproduction bundle or content-addressed fetch procedure: every producing script, dependency modules, exact input checksums/legal retrieval, environment lock, and top-level command regenerating or mechanically verifying each cited result.
issues.verification_test: In a fresh directory with only release and documented dependencies, run the top-level command and verify output hashes or justified tolerances for every cited artifact.
issues.evidence_needed: Clean-run logs, environment lock, input retrieval/checksum log, and regenerated hashes.

issues.location: source/claim_audit.py and manifest; build record current audit
issues.observed_evidence: Running bundled current checker exits FileNotFoundError because it requires submission/remote_snapshot/paper.tex and other paths not in the snapshot; the snapshot arranges them under source/artifacts. The documented 21/21 audit cannot be rerun as supplied.
issues.why_it_matters: The audit is the current hash-bound guard for revised manuscript/visual boundary. A reviewer cannot reproduce its pass or determine whether it catches mismatches in this snapshot.
issues.required_fix: Make checker snapshot-local, or bundle every dependency at required paths with manifest coverage. Validate prerequisite paths and report missing ones as structured failures rather than crashing.
issues.verification_test: Execute checker from unpacked snapshot without parent repo; it completes, verifies declared current source/evidence hashes, and reproduces summary.
issues.evidence_needed: Snapshot-local checker log and updated manifest covering all dependencies.

issues.observed_evidence: Manifest gives matching per-file hashes but no algorithm/command for root snapshot_sha256. Visual provenance covers Figure 1 only; Figure 2's likely generator depends on absent inputs and no asset-level record binds inputs to plot.
issues.why_it_matters: Per-file integrity is good, but snapshot ID is not independently derivable and second quantitative figure lacks Figure 1's provenance chain.
issues.required_fix: Document canonical snapshot-hash construction and add Figure 2 provenance with asset hash, generation command, exact inputs, and result-to-curve checks.
issues.verification_test: Recompute snapshot SHA and regenerate or mechanically verify Figure 2 from declared inputs in clean checkout.
issues.evidence_needed: Canonical hash spec plus Figure 2 generation/verification log.

ethics_concerns: No direct human-subject/deployment ethics concern. The paper discloses generated figure and avoids claiming unmeasured online correctness/cost.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A clean executable bundle regenerating or verifying all headline results from hashed inputs.
A snapshot-local claim checker binding current manuscript, figures, and evidence.
A completed preregistered ordered-online evaluation could raise the ceiling beyond remediation.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: A clean rerun failing to reproduce any reported replay, drift, or cross-carrier value.
Discovery supplied JSONs do not derive from stated splits/seeds/source.
An anonymization scan finding identity-bearing paths or metadata in final artifact.
review_limitations: This review was restricted to the frozen snapshot and did not inspect parent repositories, web, raw carriers, or unavailable inputs.
